description: Autonomous profile for one-prompt runs nobody watches: philosophy, decisions in force and the next step at session start, drive loaded first on any task-shaped prompt, and one block on a stop while the verify run is red or stale. Opt-in: copy over hooks/hooks.json.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/philosophy-hook.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/philosophy-hook.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/start-here-hook.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/start-here-hook.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/drive-entry.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/drive-entry.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/verify-stop-gate.py"; else python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/tools/verify-stop-gate.py"; fi
